Chapter 6174: It Shall Be As I Wish

Chapter 6174: It Shall Be As I Wish

Immortal Suppressor calmed down; something others couldn’t do given the circumstances. Many would be overwhelmed with the urge to run or go all out.

“Dao Brother, must you push me off the edge?” He spoke.

“Do you think you can survive today? Well, it does depend on your ability.” Li Qiye smiled.

By this point, everyone believed he could kill Immortal Suppressor without any problem.

Immortal Suppressor pondered earnestly before nodding: “I alone have no chance of escaping you, it would be miraculous.”

A few listeners felt sorry for him - a warrior at the end of the road. Immortal Suppressor had reigned and decided the fate of others. Today, his fate was no longer up to him.

“The end of the road.” An emperor said softly.

The guy was far from a hero but still the lord of Sin. It was time to bid farewell.

“Everyone faces this day eventually.” An apex emperor added.

As the saying goes - there is always a higher mountain and a better man.

“Well, let’s see what kind of miracle you can concoct. Just know that miracles for me are just common occurrences.” Li Qiye said.

After hearing his response, everyone felt how hopeless it was for Immortal Suppressor. He was a shrimp in the pot. Struggling was useless since in the end, he would be boiled and served on a plate.

“Looks like I have to die today.” Immortal Suppressor said calmly.

Everyone paused for a second, absorbing the significance of a primal ancestor accepting his fate.

“That’s right.” Li Qiye left no room for doubt.

Immortal Suppressor could see his death after hearing this. He thought he was the master of his fate all along, able to take care of this region.

He had felt weak and insignificant before. Now, Li Qiye reminded him of this lost feeling.

“No miracles, right?” Someone said.

“Who can save him? Poye?” Another said skeptically because Poye was rumored to be dead.

“Dao Brother, I won’t go down without a fight.” Immortal Suppressor chased the fear in his heart and said.

“I told you, I will give you a chance to shine. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be a fight.” Li Qiye waved his hand.

“Hahaha, then I thank you for your mercy. Let’s see how I will die today.” Immortal Suppressor laughed heartily.

“It is entirely up to you, do your best and then I’ll send you on your way.” Li Qiye said.

Reality was often cruel. Anyone facing Li Qiye at this point would feel their dao heart crumbling. Falling to the ground and accepting death was an easy way out.

“I have dominated my whole life, so I will match this success with the same intensity before death.” Immortal Suppressor became lively.

“Sure, I permit.” Li Qiye said.

“Dao Brother, allow me to show my respect.” Immortal Suppressor ascended to the sky and became resplendent.

After accepting death, his confidence returned and he acted like the ruler of Sin once more.

“Boom!” As his primal anima emerged, its affinity engulfed Sin.

Others’ anima were overshadowed instantly, clearly not on the same level. The world itself had a hard time accommodating his power.

“More than an ordinary primal ancestor.” An apex emperor became afraid.

“I am, so is the world, rise from my thoughts…” He started chanting and dimensions appeared nearby.

They came from the primal affinity and gave birth to numerous worlds and living beings.

“Actual world creation?” Emperors couldn’t do anything like this.

“Far from it, but he’s using his dao and thoughts to derive worlds.” An apex emperor took a deep breath.

“It shall be as I wish!” He raised his hands while chanting.
